title: Zero-Cost Detection of Fabricated Citations: A Staged Heuristic Approach for Computing Dissertation Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2610.28649v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI's growing role in academic writing has driven a rise in fabricated references across dissertations and student reports. We present the Fabrication Severity Stack (FSS), a three-tiered framework classifying citation fabrications by detection complexity - from non-existent references to subtle content misattribution. Building on the FSS, we propose a staged heuristic verification workflow, executable through mainstream LLM interfaces. We argue that this framework offers computer science educators/examiners a practical, zero-cost basis for embedding reference verification into the assessment of dissertation and students' reports. In a pilot study on 100 citations (20% seeded with Level 1 and Level 2 fabrications), the proposed heuristic workflow enabled mainstream LLM interfaces to correctly flag 9-10 of 10 non-existent references and partially detect metadata corruption. translated_title: 零成本检测虚假引用：面向计算学科毕业论文评审的分阶段启发式方法
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能在学术写作中扮演着日益重要的角色，这导致毕业论文和学生报告中虚假参考文献的现象不断增多。我们提出了虚假引用严重程度栈，这是一个三层框架，按检测复杂度对引用造假进行分类——从完全不存在的参考文献到微妙的内容错误归属。基于FSS，我们提出了一种分阶段启发式验证工作流，可通过主流大语言模型接口执行。我们认为，该框架为计算机科学教育者和评审者提供了一个实用且零成本的基础，可将参考文献核查嵌入毕业论文和学生报告的评审过程中。在一项针对100条引用的试点研究中（其中20%被植入一级和二级造假），所提出的启发式工作流使主流大语言模型接口能够正确标记出10条不存在的参考文献中的9-10条，并部分检测出元数据损坏。这些初步结果表明，免费可用的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了按检测难度对引用造假分级的“虚假引用严重程度栈”（FSS）三层分类框架，并设计了可通过主流大语言模型接口执行的分阶段启发式验证工作流，为零成本检测学位论文中的虚假引用提供了实用方案。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Fabrication Severity Stack (FSS), a three-tiered framework classifying citation fabrications by detection complexity, together with a staged heuristic verification workflow executable through mainstream LLM interfaces, offering a practical zero-cost approach for detecting fabricated citations in dissertations.
